name: Dragon, Ice
body:
ICE DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

This dragon seems to be made of massive ice crystals, his long talons still bloodied from a recent kill.

XP 1,200
CN Small dragon (cold)
Init +2; Senses dragon senses; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +5 natural, +1 size)
hp 42 (5d12+10)
Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +4
Immune cold, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses Vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +9 (1d6+3), 2 claws +8 (1d4+2)
Special Attacks breath weapon (20-ft. cone, DC 14, 4d4 cold plus fatigued, once per 1d4 rounds)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 10, Cha 9
Base Atk +5; CMB +6; CMD 18 (22 vs. trip)
Feats Ability Focus (breath weapon), Power Attack, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Appraise +7, Fly +10, Intimidate +7, Perception +8, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +6
Languages Draconic, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Ex)

A creature who fails his save against an ice dragon’s breath weapon becomes fatigued for 1 round.

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.
